================ ANSWER TO THE OPEN QUESTION (tested, not guessed) ================
`uv sync --frozen` does **NOT** honour `UV_DEFAULT_INDEX` for package downloads. Evidence:
with `UV_DEFAULT_INDEX=http://127.0.0.1:9/simple` (unreachable) and `UV_NO_CACHE=1`, uv still
downloaded the wheels and only failed when it needed the index for sippy's build-isolation
requirement: `error: Failed to download and build sippy==2.4.2 / cause: Failed to resolve
requirements from build-system.requires / Failed to fetch: http://127.0.0.1:9/simple/setuptools/`.
So the index build args alone are NOT sufficient: the wheels come from the absolute
`files.pythonhosted.org` URLs recorded in `uv.lock`.

Fix (as you sanctioned): keep `--frozen` exactly as before when `PIP_INDEX_URL` is the public
default, and let uv re-resolve against the index only when it is overridden:
`if [ "${PIP_INDEX_URL}" = "https://pypi.org/simple" ]; then uv sync --frozen ...; else uv sync ...; fi`
Verified: the re-resolution yields the **same 50 packages at the same versions** (name/version
sets byte-identical by diff), only `source = { registry = ... }` changes; it rewrites the lock
inside the image only. The committed `uv.lock` is untouched — md5 `ab102d7433c54d02557c380cee9435d4`
before and after every build, and `git status uv.lock` is clean.

================ BUILD: 3 defects found by actually running it ================
1st attempt (public-index path) failed for real:
  `#20 198.6 error: Failed to download g722==1.2.8 ... Failed to download distribution due to
   network timeout. Try increasing UV_HTTP_TIMEOUT (current value: 30s).`
Measured on this host: `files.pythonhosted.org` ≈15 kB/s (10.37 MB ruff wheel: timed out after
60 s having received 0.89 MB); the same wheel from tuna: 10.37 MB in 2.33 s.

Then three defects appeared, in order:
1. **Wrong interpreter.** `uv sync` installs into `/app/.venv`, but `CMD ["python", ...]` ran
   `/usr/local/bin/python`, so all three services died with `ModuleNotFoundError: No module
   named 'sippy'` (and `... 'fastapi'`). Fix: `ENV PATH="/app/.venv/bin:${PATH}"`.
2. **Next hop unreachable.** The AS originates the second leg to the hop the *rule set*
   selects; `SBC_PEER_ADDRESS` only feeds `global_config['nh_addr']` and logging. The canonical
   catalogue is `127.0.0.1`, which is per-container, so the AS sent the INVITE to
   `127.0.0.1:15061` (itself), got `next hop did not answer in time` / `AS-PEER-002`, failed
   over to `127.0.0.1:15062`, nothing. Fix: `config/routing_rules.compose.yaml` (same 17 rules,
   same hop names/ports, hops at `172.28.0.3`) + `RULES_FILE` in compose. The fixed-IP design you
   confirmed is untouched.
3. Index/frozen issue above; also raised `UV_HTTP_TIMEOUT` to 180 s and made uv's download
   cache a BuildKit cache mount.

Changed files (`git diff e0e1cff..HEAD --stat`):
  CHANGELOG.md +64 | README.md +19/-2 | config/routing_rules.compose.yaml +351 (new)
  deploy/Dockerfile.as +41/-  | deploy/Dockerfile.mock +18/- | deploy/Dockerfile.console +18/-
  deploy/docker-compose.yml +18/- | docs/acceptance/report.md +168
  docs/operations/deployment.md +92 | docs/production-gaps.md +8 | docs/roadmap.md +64/-6
Compose diff (as/mock/console): each `build:` gained
  `args: {PIP_INDEX_URL: ${PIP_INDEX_URL:-https://pypi.org/simple},
          UV_DEFAULT_INDEX: ${UV_DEFAULT_INDEX:-${PIP_INDEX_URL:-https://pypi.org/simple}}}` (nested default verified with `docker compose config`), and the AS service
  `RULES_FILE: config/routing_rules.yaml` -> `config/routing_rules.compose.yaml`.
Each Dockerfile: `ARG PIP_INDEX_URL=https://pypi.org/simple`, `ARG UV_DEFAULT_INDEX=${PIP_INDEX_URL}`
(build args are visible to RUN, so pip gets PIP_INDEX_URL and uv gets UV_DEFAULT_INDEX),
`UV_HTTP_TIMEOUT=180`, `RUN --mount=type=cache,target=/root/.cache/uv` around the conditional
`uv sync`, and `ENV PATH="/app/.venv/bin:${PATH}"`.

================ REAL CALL EVIDENCE ================
Commands: `PIP_INDEX_URL=https://pypi.tuna.tsinghua.edu.cn/simple docker compose -f deploy/docker-compose.yml build`
-> `Image third-party-as-poc-as Built` / `...console Built` / `...s-sbc-mock Built`;
`docker compose -f deploy/docker-compose.yml up -d` -> all three `Up` (as 5060/udp+8080/tcp,
s-sbc-mock 15060-15061/udp, console 8081/tcp). The mock's default `office-to-mobile` call runs
with no extra command. AS structured log, Call-ID **e48cb46795675ab0f76f5578cf5b4449**:
  {"event": "invite received on the trunk", "method": "INVITE", "called_number": "+8613800138000", "peer": "172.28.0.3:15060", "call_id": "e48cb...449"}
  {"event": "routing decision taken", "rule_id": "R-MOB-CM-40", "disposition": "route", "translated_number": "013800138000"}
  {"event": "call translated", "rule_id": "R-MOB-CM-40", "translated_number": "013800138000", "target_format": "national", "next_hops": "s-sbc-primary,s-sbc-failover"}
  {"event": "invite originated towards the next hop", "direction": "out", "peer": "172.28.0.3:15061", "called_number": "013800138000", "next_hop": "s-sbc-primary"}
  {"event": "call finished", "disposition": "completed"}
Core leg as received by the mock UAS (translated Request-URI, Via not 0.0.0.0):
  `INVITE sip:013800138000@172.28.0.3:15061 SIP/2.0` / `Via: SIP/2.0/UDP 172.28.0.2:5060;rport`
  / `Call-ID: e48cb46795675ab0f76f5578cf5b4449`, SDP and the ISC headers passed through verbatim.
Wire sequence on both legs, same Call-ID: `INVITE -> 100 Trying -> 180 Ringing -> 200 OK ->
ACK -> BYE -> 200 OK`. Reproduced by a second independent run: all three `Up`, `call finished`
`disposition: completed`, Call-ID `f421a3ad984312c6071e37ff4c2da704`, `rule_hits {"R-MOB-CM-40":1}`.
Console/API from the host: `:8081/healthz` -> `{"status":"ok","component":"console"}` (page HTTP
200, 16754 bytes); `:8080/healthz` -> `{"status":"ok","version":"0.5.0",...}`;
`:8080/api/v1/metrics` -> `{"calls_total":1,"calls_by_disposition":{"completed":1},"errors_by_code":{},"rule_hits":{"R-MOB-CM-40":1},"peer_status":{...:"reachable"}}`;
`:8080/api/v1/traces/e48cb...449` -> the Call-ID keyed trace.
`docker compose down` afterwards: 0 containers, 0 networks, 0 volumes of this project; the five
host ports released.

================ GATES ================
`ruff format --check .` 67 files already formatted; `ruff check .` All checks passed!;
`mypy` Success: no issues found in 20 source files; `pytest tests -q` **120 passed**.
(`docker compose config -q` still validates.)

================ COMMITS (no tag, no push) ================

  2edd7b4 docs(p1): mark P1 done with the compose call evidence
  2c99549 docs(p1): record the compose demo evidence in the acceptance report
  8d3b439 chore(p1): keep the P1 commits to the deploy and docs change set

================ WHAT DID NOT WORK / THINGS YOU SHOULD KNOW ================
- **The public-PyPI build path was not run to completion here.** Only the mirror build was
  exercised — `files.pythonhosted.org` at ≈15 kB/s makes it impossible. The default path is
  unchanged in kind (still `uv sync --frozen` against public PyPI) but it is verified by
  inspection, not by a finished build. Stated in `docs/acceptance/report.md` open items.
- **I made a git mistake and fixed it non-destructively.** Before my first commit the working
  tree already had `docs/3rdPartyAS_Poc_Introduction.pptx` **staged** (`MM`), so `git commit`
  swept that binary into b5ad287 (the deck is open in an editor — `docs/~$3rdPartyAS_Poc_Introduction.pptx`
  lock file is present). I did not rewrite history (`git commit --amend`/rebase is against the
  repo's git rules); commit 8d3b439 restores the deck to its previous revision and I put the
  working-tree copy back byte-for-byte (md5 `10f61b7de335e44b90bae8eed0551cf0`, 812837 bytes), so
  the author's in-progress edit is intact. `git diff e0e1cff..HEAD` no longer lists the pptx. If
  you would rather I squash those four into two, say so and I will (needs history rewrite).
- **I stopped a leftover local process stack on the host.** `uv run python -m as_app.main`,
  `... -m s_sbc_mock.main` and `... -m console.main` (≈50 min old) held 5060/udp, 15060-15061/udp,
  8080 and 8081, so `docker compose up` could not bind. I sent `SIGTERM` (the AS shuts down
  gracefully) and did not restart them. They are not mine to leave running, but flag it if you
  wanted them up.
- **`git status` leaves three entries that are not mine:** ` M docs/3rdPartyAS_Poc_Introduction.pptx`
  (the author's in-progress deck edit, deliberately left uncommitted), `?? .codebuddy/` (expected),
  `?? docs/~$3rdPartyAS_Poc_Introduction.pptx` (the Office lock file of the open deck — I left it
  alone since the file is open in an editor). Everything else is committed and `uv.lock` is unchanged.
- **Two new POC shortcuts are registered** in `docs/production-gaps.md`: the rule set is now
  duplicated per environment (`config/routing_rules.compose.yaml`) because the catalogue address
  cannot yet come from the environment, and a non-default index triggers a build-time, image-local
  re-resolution. The clean long-term fix for the first one — allow `${SBC_PEER_ADDRESS}` in the
  catalogue — is a small `src/` change I deliberately did not make.
- P2's by-hand failure branches (`+999...` -> 404, premium -> 603) were **not** exercised in the
  compose stack; P2 stays `[Required · Status: Open]` with a note that the stack it needs now exists.
- Raw evidence logs (build, AS, mock, console, the core-leg INVITE) are in `artifacts/p1/`, which is
  gitignored; the excerpts are inlined in the committed docs.
